reviewCadence: Quarterly for profile metrics; on release for repositories, tools and experience records

statusDefinitions.external-public-record: The cited record is publicly accessible on a third-party platform.
statusDefinitions.owner-supplied-snapshot: The value was transcribed from an authenticated owner export, dated professional record or explicitly labelled owner-supplied professional account and linked to a public record where available.
statusDefinitions.site-register: The value is counted from Gurjas's dated public register or production inventory; it is not an independent third-party attestation.

entries.claim: The public publications register lists 10 journal articles and 4 book chapters.
entries.verificationMethod: Counted from the dated publication lists; DOI links are supplied for journal articles where available.
entries.limitations: The aggregate count is maintained by Gurjas. Readers should use the item-level DOI and publisher links for independent checks.

entries.claim: Dated owner-supplied snapshots record 204 Google Scholar citations, h-index 8, i10-index 8; 14 public SSRN papers, 6,886 views, 1,300 downloads and top 3.2%; and 63 Web of Science review records covering 56 manuscripts.
entries.sourceLabel: Google Scholar, SSRN and Web of Science author-profile snapshots
entries.verificationMethod: Transcribed from authenticated or owner-supplied profile exports and cross-linked from the public principal-consultant profile to Google Scholar, SSRN and Web of Science.
entries.limitations: Profile metrics change continuously, platform coverage differs and some authenticated totals cannot be reproduced from public pages alone. The dated snapshots—not live APIs—are the source for displayed values.

entries.claim: The dated master CV records at least 30 postgraduate and doctoral-level projects guided or evaluated, plus two separate primary field-research programmes with more than 500 respondents each.
entries.sourceLabel: Dr. Jaskirat Singh master academic CV, updated 28 June 2026
entries.verificationMethod: Cross-checked the dated CV statements against the public principal-consultant profile, publication record and linked professional profiles where applicable.
entries.limitations: The project count is a minimum reported in the owner-supplied CV and does not mean 30 paid clients, 30 completed Ph.D. supervisions or 30 Gurjas engagements. The two field programmes are distinct doctoral and postdoctoral research programmes.

entries.claim: The founder reports recurring confidential enquiries involving failed outsourced thesis work, uncertain data provenance and journal-identity or indexing claims made through publication intermediaries.
entries.verificationMethod: Published as a bounded owner-supplied recurring-pattern account from Dr. Jaskirat Singh, with identities withheld and no formal prevalence estimate.
entries.limitations: The reports were not collected as a research dataset or incident register. Payment amounts, intermediary roles and institutional handling were reported by enquirers and are not presented as independently audited findings. No named person or institution is implicated.

entries.claim: The public Global Findex replication deposit documents 101,528 adults across 97 economies for 2021–2024.
entries.verificationMethod: Checked against the DOI-resolved Zenodo record and its deposited documentation.
entries.limitations: The deposit documents a research dataset and pipeline; it does not independently validate every analytical decision or finding.

entries.claim: The public AUCR deposit covers 36 jurisdictions, with 34 in the analytical sample, 4 pillars and 3 weighting schemes.
entries.verificationMethod: Checked against the DOI-resolved Zenodo record and its deposited codebook and pipeline.
entries.limitations: The robustness range describes rank agreement across disclosed specifications; it is not a confidence interval or causal estimate.

entries.claim: Eleven research planning and evidence tools are publicly available without sign-up.
entries.verificationMethod: Matched the contract registry one-to-one against eleven public tool routes: nine production tools, one beta tool and one living resource.
entries.limitations: Availability is a site inventory, not a claim of fitness for a particular research decision. Beta and living-resource status are preserved rather than presented as production maturity; every tool has its own decision boundary and limitations.
